2.text: The herdsmen, of course, never count their reindeer, nor are they able

3.text: to remember all their animals by their looks, as has been asserted by travellers.¹
3.resolved: travellers.¹: ¹ = U+00B9 SUPERSCRIPT ONE, footnote reference marker (mz/ocr rendered it as a stray ']')

4.text: In the larger herds they know only the more conspicuous animals, such as

5.text: breeding-bucks, old dams, harness-animals, etc. If there be any loss, they

6.text: become aware of it only by the absence of one of them. Of the smaller

7.text: animals they take little notice, nor do they care much about them.

38.text: different localities have different systems of names, but for the third and the

39.text: fourth month most of them have names signifying “false reindeer-birth month”

40.text: and “genuine reindeer-birth month.” ³ Of course, the twelve lunar months do
